signals.name: s1_vol_distance
signals.reason: A binary pays if price ends above target; how many volatility-units away it is now is the core driver of that chance.

signals.name: s2_exchange_imbalance
signals.reason: More resting bid than ask depth means buyers absorb sell flow more easily, a known short-horizon price-pressure effect.

signals.name: s3_momentum
signals.reason: Large orders are split over minutes and news diffuses gradually across venues, which can produce short continuation.

signals.name: s4_lead_lag
signals.reason: Price discovery happens first on whichever venue gets the informed flow; the median proxy lags it.

signals.name: s5_kalshi_book
signals.reason: Informed Kalshi traders show up as one-sided resting depth and as mid moves the slow-updating market has not finished.
